result.instructions: Tools for Chargebee, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Chargebee data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run chargebee_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run chargebee_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run chargebee_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. chargebee_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: chargebee_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, newest first. Filter by email or creation time. Chargebee API: GET /customers.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response's `next_offset`.

created_after.description: Unix timestamp; only customers created after this (→ created_at[after]).
